# Transfer layer

How large documents get into and out of the tools without passing through the
model.
With mcp 1.30.0, a `tools/call` body over 4 MiB is answered `413 Request body too large` from `Content-Length` before any tool runs; 1 MB and 3.5 MB are accepted.
mcp 1.28 and earlier have no cap.
Of ten Shroud scenes, seven fit under that cap; the three largest (4.8, 9.2 and 10.9 MB) and every splat scene (49 to 65 MB of text) do not.
`path=` is refused over HTTP, so a hosted server had no way to take a large file at all.
A `-> str` tool result is sent twice (`content[].text` and `structuredContent.result`), so a 10 MB result is 20 MB on the wire. The four blob tools use `structured_output=False`
Synchronous tools run on the event loop: while a 100 MB `validate_x3d` ran, nothing else was answered for 6.7 s. Documents of 1 MiB or more now run in a worker thread.
Synchronous tools run on the event loop: while a 100 MB `validate_x3d` ran, nothing else was answered for 6.7 s.
Documents of 1 MiB or more now run in a worker thread.

Under stdio there is no upload route; pass `path=` as before, or `blob_put(path="/abs/scene.x3d")`
to get an id you can reuse.
